mapper.insert: INSERT INTO squad_copy_operation (source_workspace_id, source_squad_id, user_id, request_id, target_workspace_id, request_fingerprint, source_snapshot_ref, status) VALUES (#{sourceWorkspaceId}, #{sourceSquadId}, #{userId}, #{requestId}, #{targetWorkspaceId}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{sourceSnapshotRef}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE squad_copy_operation SET status = 'SUCCESS', target_squad_id = #{targetSquadId}, error_code = NULL, error_message = NULL, resource_cleanup_json = NULL, gmt_modified = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'

UPDATE squad_copy_operation SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, resource_cleanup_json = #{resourceCleanupJson}, gmt_modified = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
